title.zh: FLUX 3 Image：用边界框控制图像
title.en: FLUX 3 Image Puts Bounding Boxes in Control

excerpt.zh: FLUX 3 Image主打逐像素创作，通过边界框、场景提示词和画布比例安排元素；其能力边界与开放条件仍需更多资料验证。
excerpt.en: FLUX 3 Image emphasizes pixel-level control with bounding boxes and scene prompts, while access terms and capabilities still need verification.

text.zh: FLUX 3 Image：从描述到布局控制
text.en: FLUX 3 Image: From Prompts to Layout Control

text.zh: FLUX 3 Image是Black Forest Labs展示的新图像生成模型，核心卖点不是只用一句提示词生成画面，而是让创作者进一步安排画布中的元素。页面将其定位为“控制每一个像素”，并提供从零开始构图的工作流。
text.en: FLUX 3 Image is a new image-generation model presented by Black Forest Labs. Its pitch goes beyond generating a scene from one prompt: creators can also arrange elements across a canvas. The page frames this as control over every pixel and presents a workflow for composing images from scratch.

text.zh: 边界框与比例构成主要工作流
text.en: Bounding Boxes Define the FLUX 3 Image Workflow

text.zh: 用户可以先选择画布比例，再用边界框指定元素的位置和范围，最后结合场景提示词生成图像。页面说明画布使用横纵坐标均为0到1000的网格，因此布局意图可以用相对明确的空间信息表达，而不只依赖自然语言。
text.en: The workflow starts with an aspect ratio, then uses bounding boxes to specify where elements should appear and how much space they should occupy. A scene prompt completes the instruction. The page describes a canvas whose horizontal and vertical coordinates each run from 0 to 1000, giving layout intent a more explicit spatial form than natural language alone.

text.zh: 亮点明确，但性能问题仍待回答
text.en: FLUX 3 Image Still Needs Evidence on Performance

text.zh: 页面展示了节日场景、冬季画面、针织冰山村和地铁等示例，并提供试用、文档及商业权重咨询入口。这说明产品试图服务需要可控构图的创作者，但现有资料没有给出生成质量基准、速度、成本、可用接口细节或复杂布局下的稳定性。对实际采用者而言，边界框能否持续带来准确且可复现的结果，仍是最重要的开放问题。
text.en: The page shows examples including a festival scene, winter frames, a knitted iceberg village, and a subway setting. It also links to a trial, documentation, and a conversation about commercial weights. That points to a product aimed at creators who need structured composition, but the supplied material does not provide quality benchmarks, speed, cost, API details, or reliability under complex layouts. For adopters, the key open question is whether bounding boxes consistently produce accurate and repeatable results.
